name: Trayzero
tagline: A local-first Getting Things Done task manager
description:
Trayzero is a free, open-source Getting Things Done (GTD) app. Tasks and notes are stored on your device, and no Trayzero account is required. There is no cross-device task sync.

Android builds use RevenueCat for purchase checks and analytics; optional integrations may contact the services you choose. See https://trayzero.app/privacy for details.
